briefing: Elite: Mirror Tempest Gate: Ascension Seal. Kami advances through tempest mirror gate where false lanes split from sacred ground while the Gate tests whether balance is defended by precision.

missionIntro.speaker: Kami Titan Voice
missionIntro.text: The field asks for proof. One active Titan enter, and The Spirit-Moon Gate will remember how we answer.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Threats emerge to test Kami Mirror Tempest: pressure first, revelation only when the field is held.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Hold the lane, read the hazard, and spend movement as if it were blood.

victory.speaker: Kami Titan Voice
victory.text: The Gate has not yielded. It has recorded that we did not break.

defeat.speaker: Kami Titan Voice
defeat.text: Fall back before the wound learns our full shape.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: This mission keeps Kami doctrine intact: Their secrecy protects sacred balance but makes allies fear what they cannot see.
